rows.role_title: Председатель Правительства — Chairman of the Government
rows.text: Under Article 83(a) of the Constitution the decree appoints Kiriyenko Sergei Vladilenovich Chairman of the Government of the Russian Federation. Signed 'Президент Российской Федерации Б.Ельцин', 24 April 1998, No. 436.
